# AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1

Unmodified `ffx_a.h` and `ffx_fsr1.h` from AMD's v1.0.2 release:
https://github.com/GPUOpen-Effects/FidelityFX-FSR/tree/v1.0.2/ffx-fsr

The MIT license and AMD copyright are included in each header. Only the full-precision
EASU and RCAS shader paths are used. Host integration is in
`src/graphics/presentation/fsr`; shader entry points are in `gpu_fsr1.frag`.
